gazetteer_names_needed.name: Mannar Island
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: island off the north-west coast of Sri Lanka joined to the mainland by causeway, about 79.85E 9.0N; only the district Mannārama exists, so the dossier uses a 15 km circle

gaps.what: No separate dossier: the Cliopatria row 'Portuguese Colonies' (1564-1910, 32 shapes) and 'Portuguese Empire' (1502-1823) share Wikidata Q200464 and the article 'Portuguese Empire' and are one state; the earlier slug portuguese-empire (group am-06) already exists, lists both Names in cliopatria_names, reviews all 32 Colonies shapes and validates. A second dossier would double every Colonies verdict.

Extent of the Portuguese holdings is a minimum (20 cells from 1597, 28 from 1619): the interior lands overrun by Kandy at Randeniwela (2 August 1630) and in 1639-1640, the dates and previous owners of Galle, Batticaloa and Trincomalee (ledger 1597, confidence 1), and the fall of Negombo, Kalutara and Mannar between 1656 and 1658 are not on the five pages opened

Pages that would settle it: Sinhalese–Portuguese War, Siege of Colombo (1655–1656), Battle of Randeniwela, Battle of Danture, Dutch Ceylon (budget of 5 pages spent). The article 'Portuguese Ceylon' itself is a stub with no territorial history.

Colonies-row Ceylon cells (28 in 1570, 122 in 1645) in portuguese-empire.json overlap this dossier; the 1640-1647 Colonies shape still holds Galle, Batticaloa and Trincomalee after their fall in 1639-1640

counterparts_needing_dossiers.name: Dutch Ceylon
counterparts_needing_dossiers.group: sa-06 (another part); Cliopatria's row starts only in 1687, the dossier should start by 1639 to receive Batticaloa, Trincomalee, Galle, Colombo and Jaffna

problems: portuguese-colonies has no dossier of its own: it is the Asian half of the Portuguese Empire state and is covered by portuguese-empire.json (am-06, validates, both Names in cliopatria_names, 32 Colonies shapes reviewed). The colour agent should give portuguese-colonies the colour of portuguese-empire. If the orchestrator wants a pointer file anyway it must not repeat the keyframe verdicts.

All 11 Cliopatria 'Portuguese Ceylon' shapes (1507-1686) are marked wrong: measured with the gazetteer they hold all 70 cells of the Kandyan upcountry districts (Kandy, Matale, Nuwara Eliya, Badulla, Moneragala, Kegalle, Polonnaruwa) and none of the Colonies row's 1570 coast; from 1595 they add the whole north 24 years before the Jaffna conquest and after 1658 they grow to 87% of the island. Kandy has no Cliopatria row, so kingdom-of-kandy (sa-04) may use those cells.

portuguese-ceylon and portuguese-empire both draw Portuguese Ceylon (the Colonies shapes keep Sri Lankan cells in 1564-1581 and 1640-1658) and Cliopatria's Spanish Empire row draws the Ceylon coast in 1582-1639: the compile step must pick one drawer; recommended portuguese-ceylon.
dutch-ceylon (written in another part) must carry the matching gains of 1639, 1640, 1656 and June 1658 and the 1654-1656 Colombo contest; its counterpart strings in this dossier are 'dutch-ceylon'.

WebFetch returned extracts rather than full pages and the 'Portuguese Ceylon' article is a stub; quotes in the dossier are the extracts' words. The corrected Ceylon shape is therefore a minimum built only from places the pages name.
